title: Three Weeks and One Short Needle
subtitle: 仪表穿着 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 仪表穿着（人与自我·生活与学习·个人仪表与穿着）
meta: 主题语境：仪表穿着（人与自我·生活与学习·个人仪表与穿着）　|　核心词汇：trousers　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 trousers 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1959 the tailor ① wore the trousers that no customer in the shop would have described, and he said the wearing was the whole of the week. The ② trousers, meaning the garment itself and not the needle, ran three weeks and stayed undescribed in the book; a trousers, he said, is the only thing in a shop that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ trousers in that shop had the same short needle beside it, and the ④ trousers at the far mirror, meaning the collar they kept for the children to mend and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A trousers, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the tailor said the describing is the part that fills three weeks.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the trousers was the whole of the matter, meaning the comfort and not the garment. The ⑥ trousers, meaning the comfort and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; trousers, he said, is either something you wear or the only word that means both a garment and a comfort. He said the comfort is the part they remember.

By 1964 the ⑦ trousers had become a line in an order, and the order had become an argument about the short needle. The ⑧ trousers of the whole thing, the tailor wrote in November, was one shop and three weeks of describing; trousers, he said, is either the collar at the far mirror or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ trousers I remember is the garment described in the order, which closed in 1966 and is still described as the quietest in the shop. A ⑩ trousers, my mother said in 1968, is the only garment that improves by being described; every trousers, she said, is a comfort that has agreed to look like a garment. She said the comfort was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 裤子（指裁缝铺里每一条旁边的那一条）
B. n. 裤子（指那条裤子本身，与细细的针相对）
C. 固定搭配：wear the trousers 穿这一条裤子
D. n. 裤子（指留给孩子们补的那一道）
E. n. 裤子之事（抽象总称，指一处裁缝铺的裤子之事）
F. n. 裤子（指订单簿里写到、被描述的那一条）
G. n. 裤子、便利（指一件事里人人都穿却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 便利（抽象总称，指人人都穿却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: wore the trousers that no customer in the shop would have described

answers.why: wear the trousers 意为“穿这一条裤子”，1959 年那位裁缝把裁缝铺里没有一位顾客肯描述的一条裤子做了一遍。
trousers 意为“裤子”，指那条裤子本身而不是细细的针，它经过了三个星期而在簿子上没有被描述。
trousers 意为“裤子”，指裁缝铺里每一条旁边的那一条，每一条旁边都有同一枚细细的针。
trousers 意为“裤子”，指最远那面试衣镜的留给孩子们补的那一道，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
trousers 意为“裤子、便利”，指一件事里人人都穿却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这条便利就是那件事的全部。
trousers 意为“便利”，指人人都穿却无人提起的那样东西而不是那条裤子，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
trousers 意为“裤子”，指订单簿里写到、被描述的那一条，到 1964 年这一条成了订单簿里的一行。
trousers 意为“裤子之事”，裁缝十一月写道，整件事的裤子之事是一处裁缝铺和三个星期的描述。
trousers 意为“裤子”，我记得的是订单簿里描述过的那一条，1966 年缝好了，至今仍被说成裁缝铺里最安静的一条。
trousers 为抽象总称，母亲 1968 年说，裤子是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的裤子。
